name_vi: Tấm kê nồi cách mặt bàn
description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A square bamboo-ringed woven pad rests on four short solid feet. Side: The feet create a visible air gap beneath the thick woven center. Rear: The underside has crossed solid bamboo rails supporting the pad. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT of this square low pot stand with a woven top and FOUR short downward bamboo feet. Create ONE REAR catalog photo, camera orbiting exactly 180 degrees while the object remains resting in its original natural pose: square woven top stays HORIZONTAL, all four feet still point DOWN and touch the studio floor. Do not stand it upright, tip it backward, flip it over, or display its underside face-on. The rear view sees the opposite outer bamboo edge and rear feet, with only a small low gap under the stand; any underside braces may be partly hidden. Preserve exact tan color, plain basket weave, dimensions, four feet, rim and bindings. Match the same gentle downward front camera elevation, soft studio light, warm-white background and shadow. No text, markings, numbers, logos, props or other objects.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
